changeSet.comment: Remove the superseded semantic-modeling backend and its one-off migration ledger. The change is fail-closed: any business row or retirement evidence must be migrated or archived before the deployment may continue.
changeSet.sql: LOCK TABLE modeling_legacy_api_usage, modeling_legacy_object_migration, modeling_legacy_object_migration_batch, modeling_model_registration_step, semantic_business_object, semantic_dimension, semantic_generated_artifact, semantic_metric, semantic_model, semantic_model_dimension, semantic_model_metric, semantic_model_review_log, semantic_model_run, semantic_object_table_mapping, semantic_subject_domain IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE

DO $$ BEGIN IF ( (SELECT count(*) FROM semantic_subject_domain) + (SELECT count(*) FROM semantic_business_object) + (SELECT count(*) FROM semantic_object_table_mapping) + (SELECT count(*) FROM semantic_dimension) + (SELECT count(*) FROM semantic_metric) + (SELECT count(*) FROM semantic_model) + (SELECT count(*) FROM semantic_generated_artifact) + (SELECT count(*) FROM semantic_model_dimension) + (SELECT count(*) FROM semantic_model_metric) + (SELECT count(*) FROM semantic_model_review_log) + (SELECT count(*) FROM semantic_model_run) + (SELECT count(*) FROM modeling_legacy_object_migration_batch) + (SELECT count(*) FROM modeling_legacy_object_migration) + (SELECT count(*) FROM modeling_legacy_api_usage) + (SELECT count(*) FROM modeling_model_registration_step) ) <> 0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'LEGACY_SEMANTIC_MODELING_RETIREMENT_LOCKED_RECHECK_FAILED'; END IF; END $$;
